values.note: Reservation only from May 15 through Columbus Day: 'Walk ins are not allowed' (recreation.gov or 877-444-6777); same-day booking allowed. The site must be occupied the first night and may not be left unattended more than 24 hours. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. The recreation.gov peak season runs May 15 - October 15 (2026, 2027). Run by the Forest Service, not a concession.

note: Ten primitive campsites lining 67-acre Lyman Lake, Hiawatha NF (Rapid River/Manistique district), off Forest Roads 2218 and 2880 (site 1 off FR 2218; site 10 is isolated on its own access road). For a 23-ft motorhome the best bets are site 5 (75x50 ft, good road access) and site 8 (level, on a hill over the lake); site 3 is a big open area but listed for tents and trailers; sites 4 and 9 have little turn-around room, 6 slopes and 7 is tents-recommended. Back-in boat access with parking between sites 6 and 7; best swimming at sites 3 and 5. Bluegill, pumpkinseed, rock bass, largemouth bass and northern pike. --Claude
